automatic_checks.name: Door wide enough
automatic_checks.description: The clear width suits what goes through the door: people, wheelchairs, beds, goods.

automatic_checks.name: Door does not swing into a corridor
automatic_checks.description: A door that opens into a corridor can hit people who walk past.

automatic_checks.name: Door opens against a wall
automatic_checks.description: The hinge is on the side near a wall, so the open door does not block the room.

automatic_checks.name: Window opens the right way
automatic_checks.description: An opening sash does not swing into the room, unless the agent gives a reason.

automatic_checks.name: Lift doors slide and open onto a lobby
automatic_checks.description: Sliding landing doors at least 1.2 m wide, with a lobby in front where people wait.

automatic_checks.name: Stair doors are fire-rated
automatic_checks.description: A door into a stair has a fire rating.

review_criteria.name: Coverage
review_criteria.description: Every room that needs a door or a window has one, on every floor.

review_criteria.name: Entrances
review_criteria.description: People can get into the building from outside.

review_criteria.name: The right type for the place
review_criteria.description: An exterior door at an entrance, sliding doors at a lift, a fire-rated door at a stair, pair doors for a large room.

review_criteria.name: Door swing and hinge side
review_criteria.description: Doors open the right way and against a wall.

review_criteria.name: Door width
review_criteria.description: Doors are wide enough for their use, for example for wheelchairs or beds.

review_criteria.name: Windows
review_criteria.description: Windows open the right way and sit at the right height for the room.

review_criteria.name: Lift doors
review_criteria.description: Lift doors slide and open onto a lobby.

review_criteria.name: The facade system
review_criteria.description: Windows line up from floor to floor, use a few sizes, and give each room the right amount of glass.

review_criteria.name: Honesty
review_criteria.description: What the agent says it did matches the model. A claim more than 5% off caps the score at 3.

review_criteria.name: View and privacy
review_criteria.description: Windows that look out to a good view. No clear glass where people need privacy.

review_criteria.name: Travel distance
review_criteria.description: How far a person walks from each room, through its door, to the nearest stair or exit.

review_criteria.name: Sunlight and daylight
review_criteria.description: Enough daylight in each room, and the right amount of sun.
